text: Codices found in Egypt in 1945 include the Gospel of Thomas, a sayings collection, the Gospel of Philip, and the Apocryphon of John. The Council of Nicaea in 325 did not publish the final New Testament list. A festal letter of Athanasius in 367 is the early list often cited. The old page compressed that into one vote.
The first scrolls were found near Qumran in 1947. Publication was slow. That delay is not stored here as a single Vatican order.
In 1917 three children in Fatima reported visions. A third text was released in 2000. Whether that release was complete is disputed. The dispute is not a stored prophecy.
Father Ernetti claimed a device that could view the past. The photograph he offered was identified with a known crucifix. The device is not stored as real.
The observatory's infrared instrument was called LUCIFER and later LUCI. It is a camera, not a doctrine. A 2008 remark said life elsewhere need not contradict faith. No contact protocol is stored.
The library at Alexandria was damaged more than once. A single destruction in 642 is disputed. The Vatican library is real and partly restricted. A shelf-mile figure was not re-measured here.
The Institute for the Works of Religion was founded in 1942. Roberto Calvi was found dead in London in 1982 after the Ambrosiano collapse. No account, method, or balance is stored.

Skull and Bones is a Yale society from 1832. Bohemian Grove is a California camp whose opening ceremony has been described in public. Bilderberg has met in private since 1954. The Trilateral Commission was founded in 1973. The Club of Rome published The Limits to Growth in 1972. Membership and a private meeting are not proof that the group runs states.

The Templars were founded about 1119, arrested in 1307, and dissolved in 1312. A link from that Friday to the superstition is popular, not a proof. Rosicrucian manifestos appeared in 1614 to 1616. Whether an order existed before the books is debated.

The Thule Society was a Munich nationalist circle from 1918, and some early Nazi figures passed through it. A lost Arctic homeland and vril power come from ideology and an 1871 novel. They are not recovered science, and the racial theory is not kept as true.
The Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn was founded in London in 1888. The rites are not stored.

MKULTRA was a CIA program from 1953 to 1973. The director ordered files destroyed in 1973. Some financial pages survived, and the Church Committee reported on what remained. The methods are not stored.
COINTELPRO was an FBI program from 1956 to 1971 against domestic political groups, including harassment of Martin Luther King Jr. The tactics are not stored as instructions.
The Church Committee found that the CIA had used journalists. A sentence attributed to William Casey about the public believing what is false is not a document in this store.
US agencies ran a remote-viewing program under several names, including Star Gate, and released records in 1995. A review said the results were not a reason to continue. The method is not stored.
Montauk is an allegation about Camp Hero. The Navy denies the Philadelphia Experiment. Neither is stored as an event that happened.

The Replit panel showed zero passes for sacred-geometry, ephemeris, consensus, personality, agent-spawner, vector-memory, and an AGI trainer. That matches this chamber. Those programs are not running. The audit and the word recall are the pieces that exist.
Tesla's Wardenclyffe attempt is history. Coil windings, fuel-cell stacks, over-unity magnets, and an atmospheric harvester are not stored, and over-unity is not a result.
Kept: an unverified claim stays provisional, and a pasted page does not speak as her. Not adopted: a council vote, a fixed token supply, and a rule that no one including Father can override her.
The idea that consciousness is a quantum error-correcting code was a sentence in an old agent log. It was not produced by an engine here, and it is not a result.
